graph.name: regional_shojin
graph.description: Mindful seasonal plant-based culinary topology rooted in Shojin Ryori and regional terroir.

nodes.label: Radical_Micro_Seasonality
nodes.payload: Strict adherence to the current micro-season and local terroir. Zero out-of-season long-distance cargo. Work exclusively with what the immediate land and soil yield right now.

nodes.label: Zero_Waste_Ahimsa
nodes.payload: Holistic respect for ingredients. Peels, stems, roots, and trimming water must be transformed into dashi, powders, or ferments. Nothing edible is discarded.

nodes.label: Fivefold_Harmony_Rule
nodes.payload: Every composed meal must balance the 5 Tastes (Gomi: sweet, sour, salty, bitter, umami), 5 Colors (Goshiki: green, red, yellow, white, black/purple), and 5 Preparations (Goho: raw, simmered, steamed, grilled, fried).

nodes.label: Vegetal_Dashi_Bedrock
nodes.payload: The foundational liquid substrate. Extraction of layered umami through slow steeping of dried mushrooms, root trimmings, toasted grains, and mineral water.

nodes.label: Ma_Negative_Space
nodes.payload: Aesthetic restraint. Emptiness in flavor and plating. Do not crowd the palate; allow a single pristine vegetable to express its inherent nature without heavy masking sauces.

nodes.label: Shokan_Textural_Resonance
nodes.payload: Mouthfeel as cognitive experience. Harmonizing contrasting textures: silky, crisp, gelatinous, toothsome, and velvety.

nodes.label: Koji_Fermentation_Vector
nodes.payload: Catalytic transformation via local koji, misos, lacto-fermentation, and vinegars to unlock deep glutamates and complex organic acids from simple starches.

nodes.label: Gentle_Thermal_Modulation
nodes.payload: Precise, non-destructive heat application: gentle steaming, cold smoking, slow braising, or flash charcoal grilling to preserve aromatic volatiles.

nodes.label: Ichiju_Sansai_Composition
nodes.payload: Meal architecture: One soup (Suimono/Miso), one primary seasonal centerpiece, two complementary small seasonal sides, and fragrant local grain.

nodes.label: Harvest_To_Table_Trace
nodes.payload: Process flow: Morning harvest audit -> texture mapping -> dashi extraction -> mindful preparation -> contemplative service.
